description:
Design a radial plate cam profile for an automated packaging machine. The cam must rotate 360 degrees and drive a follower with the following displacement sequence: (1) 0°-90°: Dwell at 0 lift; (2) 90°-180°: Rise 2 units using Simple Harmonic Motion; (3) 180°-270°: Dwell at 2 units lift; (4) 270°-360°: Return to 0 units using Simple Harmonic Motion. The Base Circle Radius is 3 units. 

Create a parametric curve in GeoGebra that represents this cam profile. You will need to define a piecewise displacement function (using the 'If' command) and then generate the profile using the 'Curve' command with polar-to-cartesian conversion equations: x = (R + f(t)) * cos(t), y = (R + f(t)) * sin(t). 

Save your project as 'cam_profile.ggb' in ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/.
